name: spindev-deploy
description: Deployment-target + on-prem infrastructure reference skills for spinlockdevelopment. Ships flyio (fly.io provisioning + always-on app config + day-2 ops), sprites-dev (correct-usage rules for the sprite CLI and sprites.dev API on Windows/Git Bash), forgejo (self-hosted git server in Docker for GitHub mirroring + on-prem-only repos, pinned to Forgejo LTS), and restic-backup (encrypted two-destination backup chain with append-only NAS rest-server + write-only Cloudflare R2 + healthchecks.io ping + restore drill). flyio and sprites-dev back their rules with PreToolUse Bash hooks (fly-guard, sprite-guard) that catch documented failure modes at execution time.
